sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_validar_teto_pronaf
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_pronaf_proposta</collection><condition/><description>Impede a gravacao de propostas cujo valor solicitado ultrapasse o teto normativo da linha PRONAF BNB</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Validar Teto Normativo PRONAF</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><script><![CDATA[
(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    var tetos = {
        'A': 50000,
        'A2': 50000,
        'C': 30000,
        'custeio': 250000,
        'custeio_renovacao': 250000,
        'mulher': 100000,
        'jovem': 30000,
        'investimento': 210000,
        'bioeconomia': 50000,
        'agroecologia': 60000
    };

    var linha = current.u_linha_credito ? current.u_linha_credito.toString().toLowerCase() : '';
    var valor = parseFloat(current.u_valor_solicitado) || 0;
    
    // Tenta casar a linha
    for (var key in tetos) {
        if (linha.indexOf(key) !== -1) {
            var tetoPermitido = tetos[key];
            if (valor > tetoPermitido) {
                gs.addErrorMessage('BLOQUEIO DE CONFORMIDADE: O valor solicitado de R$ ' + valor.toFixed(2) + ' ultrapassa o teto oficial de R$ ' + tetoPermitido.toFixed(2) + ' para a linha PRONAF selecionada.');
                current.setAbortAction(true);
            }
            break;
        }
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_name>Validar Teto Normativo PRONAF</sys_name><template/><when>before</when></sys_script></record_update>
